SELECT CASE
  WHEN $1 = '' THEN ''
  WHEN $1 = (SELECT value FROM admin_settings WHERE key = 'operator_passcode_sha256') THEN 'operator'
  WHEN $1 = (SELECT value FROM admin_settings WHERE key = 'client_passcode_sha256')   THEN 'client'
  ELSE ''
END AS role;

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM receptionist_session_logs
  WHERE
    ($1 = '' OR question ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR answer ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%')
    AND (
      $2 = 'all'
      OR ($2 = 'unknown' AND is_unknown)
      OR ($2 = 'voice' AND input_type = 'audio')
      OR ($2 = 'text' AND input_type = 'text')
      OR ($2 = 'cache_hit' AND match_type = 'cache_hit')
      OR ($2 = 'fresh' AND match_type = 'fresh')
    )
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS total FROM filtered
),
page_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY timestamp DESC, id DESC
  LIMIT $3::int OFFSET $4::int
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'rows', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
      'id', id, 'timestamp', timestamp, 'question', question, 'answer', answer,
      'inputType', input_type, 'matchType', match_type, 'isUnknown', COALESCE(is_unknown, false),
      'intent', intent, 'language', language, 'latencyMs', latency_ms,
      'sessionId', session_id, 'respondedWithAudio', responded_with_audio
    ) ORDER BY timestamp DESC, id DESC) FROM page_rows), '[]'::json),
  'total', (SELECT total FROM total_count),
  'page', $5::int,
  'pageSize', $3::int
) AS result;

WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM receptionist_session_logs
  WHERE timestamp >= $1::timestamptz AND timestamp <= $2::timestamptz
),
kpi_base AS (
  SELECT
    count(*) AS total_questions,
    count(DISTINCT COALESCE(normalized_question, lower(question))) AS unique_questions,
    count(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE session_id IS NOT NULL) AS sessions,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(intent, 'question') = 'question' AND is_unknown) AS unknown_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(intent, 'question') = 'question') AS question_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE match_type = 'cache_hit') AS cache_hits,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE match_type IS NOT NULL) AS match_type_known,
    avg(latency_ms) FILTER (WHERE latency_ms IS NOT NULL) AS avg_latency,
    percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) FILTER (WHERE latency_ms IS NOT NULL) AS p95_latency,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE input_type = 'audio') AS voice_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE responded_with_audio) AS audio_reply_count,
    count(DISTINCT date_trunc('day', timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Beirut')) AS active_days,
    min(timestamp) AS first_seen,
    max(timestamp) AS last_seen
  FROM scoped
),
hour_series AS (
  SELECT h AS hour FROM generate_series(0,23) h
),
by_hour AS (
  SELECT hs.hour, count(s.*) AS cnt
  FROM hour_series hs
  LEFT JOIN scoped s ON EXTRACT(HOUR FROM s.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Beirut') = hs.hour
  GROUP BY hs.hour ORDER BY hs.hour
),
weekday_series AS (
  SELECT w AS weekday FROM generate_series(0,6) w
),
weekday_labels AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES (0,'Sunday'),(1,'Monday'),(2,'Tuesday'),(3,'Wednesday'),(4,'Thursday'),(5,'Friday'),(6,'Saturday')) AS t(weekday,label)
),
by_weekday AS (
  SELECT ws.weekday, wl.label, count(s.*) AS cnt
  FROM weekday_series ws
  JOIN weekday_labels wl ON wl.weekday = ws.weekday
  LEFT JOIN scoped s ON EXTRACT(DOW FROM s.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Beirut') = ws.weekday
  GROUP BY ws.weekday, wl.label ORDER BY ws.weekday
),
heatmap AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM s.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Beirut')::int AS weekday,
         EXTRACT(HOUR FROM s.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Beirut')::int AS hour,
         count(*) AS cnt
  FROM scoped s
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
day_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    (COALESCE(min(timestamp), now()) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Beirut')::date AS min_day,
    (COALESCE(max(timestamp), now()) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Beirut')::date AS max_day
  FROM scoped
),
day_series AS (
  SELECT gs::date AS day
  FROM day_bounds, generate_series(min_day, max_day, interval '1 day') gs
),
by_day AS (
  SELECT ds.day,
         count(s.*) AS cnt,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.is_unknown) AS unknown_cnt
  FROM day_series ds
  LEFT JOIN scoped s ON (s.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Beirut')::date = ds.day
  GROUP BY ds.day ORDER BY ds.day
),
q_groups AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(normalized_question, lower(question)) AS qkey,
         count(*) AS cnt,
         max(timestamp) AS last_asked,
         (array_agg(question ORDER BY timestamp DESC))[1] AS label,
         (array_agg(answer ORDER BY timestamp DESC))[1] AS sample_answer,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_unknown) AS unknown_cnt
  FROM scoped
  WHERE COALESCE(intent, 'question') = 'question' AND question IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY qkey
),
top_questions AS (
  SELECT * FROM q_groups ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 25
),
unk_groups AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(normalized_question, lower(question)) AS qkey,
         count(*) AS cnt,
         max(timestamp) AS last_asked,
         (array_agg(question ORDER BY timestamp DESC))[1] AS label,
         (array_agg(answer ORDER BY timestamp DESC))[1] AS sample_answer
  FROM scoped
  WHERE is_unknown AND question IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY qkey
  ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 50
),
by_language AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(language,'unknown') AS language, count(*) AS cnt FROM scoped GROUP BY 1
),
by_input_type AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(input_type,'unknown') AS input_type, count(*) AS cnt FROM scoped GROUP BY 1
),
by_match_type AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(match_type,'unknown') AS match_type, count(*) AS cnt FROM scoped GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'kpis', json_build_object(
    'totalQuestions', kb.total_questions,
    'uniqueQuestions', kb.unique_questions,
    'sessions', kb.sessions,
    'unknownCount', kb.unknown_count,
    'unknownRate', CASE WHEN kb.question_count > 0 THEN round(kb.unknown_count::numeric / kb.question_count, 4) ELSE 0 END,
    'cacheHitRate', CASE WHEN kb.match_type_known > 0 THEN round(kb.cache_hits::numeric / kb.match_type_known, 4) ELSE 0 END,
    'avgLatencyMs', CASE WHEN kb.avg_latency IS NOT NULL THEN round(kb.avg_latency)::int ELSE NULL END,
    'p95LatencyMs', CASE WHEN kb.p95_latency IS NOT NULL THEN round(kb.p95_latency)::int ELSE NULL END,
    'voiceShare', CASE WHEN kb.total_questions > 0 THEN round(kb.voice_count::numeric / kb.total_questions, 4) ELSE 0 END,
    'audioReplyShare', CASE WHEN kb.total_questions > 0 THEN round(kb.audio_reply_count::numeric / kb.total_questions, 4) ELSE 0 END,
    'avgQuestionsPerSession', CASE WHEN kb.sessions > 0 THEN round(kb.total_questions::numeric / kb.sessions, 2) ELSE 0 END,
    'activeDays', kb.active_days,
    'busiestHour', (SELECT hour FROM by_hour ORDER BY cnt DESC, hour ASC LIMIT 1),
    'busiestDay', (SELECT label FROM by_weekday ORDER BY cnt DESC, weekday ASC LIMIT 1),
    'firstSeen', kb.first_seen,
    'lastSeen', kb.last_seen
  ),
  'byHour', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('hour', hour, 'count', cnt)) FROM by_hour), '[]'::json),
  'byWeekday', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('weekday', weekday, 'label', label, 'count', cnt)) FROM by_weekday), '[]'::json),
  'heatmap', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('weekday', weekday, 'hour', hour, 'count', cnt)) FROM heatmap), '[]'::json),
  'byDay', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('day', day, 'count', cnt, 'unknown', unknown_cnt)) FROM by_day), '[]'::json),
  'topQuestions', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('question', label, 'count', cnt, 'lastAsked', last_asked, 'sampleAnswer', sample_answer, 'unknownCount', unknown_cnt)) FROM top_questions), '[]'::json),
  'unknownQuestions', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('question', label, 'count', cnt, 'lastAsked', last_asked, 'sampleAnswer', sample_answer)) FROM unk_groups), '[]'::json),
  'byLanguage', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('language', language, 'count', cnt)) FROM by_language), '[]'::json),
  'byInputType', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('inputType', input_type, 'count', cnt)) FROM by_input_type), '[]'::json),
  'byMatchType', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('matchType', match_type, 'count', cnt)) FROM by_match_type), '[]'::json)
) AS result
FROM kpi_base kb;
SELECT value FROM admin_settings WHERE key = 'typo_lexicon';

INSERT INTO admin_settings (key, value)
VALUES ('typo_lexicon', $1)
ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value
RETURNING value;

WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM receptionist_session_logs
  WHERE timestamp >= $1::timestamptz AND timestamp <= $2::timestamptz
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT
    (c->>'from') AS from_term,
    (c->>'to') AS to_term,
    (c->>'tier') AS tier
  FROM scoped, jsonb_array_elements(corrections) AS c
  WHERE corrections IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(corrections) = 'array'
),
pair_counts AS (
  SELECT from_term, to_term, count(*) AS cnt,
         (array_agg(tier ORDER BY tier))[1] AS tier
  FROM pairs
  WHERE from_term IS NOT NULL AND to_term IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY from_term, to_term
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 50
),
clarify_rows AS (
  SELECT id, timestamp, raw_question, question, answer, session_id
  FROM scoped
  WHERE match_type = 'clarify'
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 100
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'topPairs', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('from', from_term, 'to', to_term, 'count', cnt, 'tier', tier)) FROM pair_counts), '[]'::json),
  'clarifications', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'timestamp', timestamp, 'rawQuestion', raw_question, 'question', question, 'answer', answer, 'sessionId', session_id) ORDER BY timestamp DESC) FROM clarify_rows), '[]'::json)
) AS result;
